content: Shallow men believe in luck or in circumstance. Strong men believe in cause and effect.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Maturity begins when we stop attributing our outcomes to random fortune or external blame, and instead take full ownership of the laws of cause and effect.
practicalInsight: Take radical ownership of one lagging area of your life by examining your consistent daily inputs.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you blaming external circumstances for an outcome within your control?
